# Balancer BatchRelayerLibrary test vectors

Calls to `BatchRelayerLibrary` functions on Ethereum, which `BalancerRelayer.multicall` reaches with `DELEGATECALL`. Each vector decodes one call against the library's descriptor.

```solidity
enum PoolKind { WEIGHTED, LEGACY_STABLE, COMPOSABLE_STABLE, COMPOSABLE_STABLE_V2 }

struct JoinPoolRequest {
    IAsset[] assets;
    uint256[] maxAmountsIn;
    bytes userData;
    bool fromInternalBalance;
}

struct ExitPoolRequest {
    IAsset[] assets;
    uint256[] minAmountsOut;
    bytes userData;
    bool toInternalBalance;
}

struct OutputReference {
    uint256 index;
    uint256 key;
}

function setRelayerApproval(address relayer, bool approved, bytes calldata authorisation) external payable;
function joinPool(bytes32 poolId, PoolKind kind, address sender, address recipient, JoinPoolRequest memory request, uint256 value, uint256 outputReference) external payable;
function exitPool(bytes32 poolId, PoolKind kind, address sender, address payable recipient, ExitPoolRequest memory request, OutputReference[] calldata outputReferences) external payable;
```

Descriptor: [`example-balancer-relayer-library.json`](./example-balancer-relayer-library.json)

All vectors are sent by `0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111` to `0xeA66501dF1A00261E3bB79D1E90444fc6A186B62` on Ethereum.

## Join the 80BAL-20WETH pool with BAL and ETH

Pool kind `0` is weighted; join kind `1` is `EXACT_TOKENS_IN_FOR_BPT_OUT`. ETH is the zero address in `assets`.

Arguments:

```
value: 1 ETH
poolId: 0x5c6ee304399dbdb9c8ef030ab642b10820db8f56000200000000000000000014
kind: 0
sender: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
recipient: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
request:
  assets:
    [0]: 0xba100000625a3754423978a60c9317c58a424e3D
    [1]: 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000
  maxAmountsIn:
    [0]: 1000000000000000000000
    [1]: 1000000000000000000
  userData: abi.encode(...)
    joinKind: 1
    amountsIn:
      [0]: 1000000000000000000000
      [1]: 1000000000000000000
    minBptAmountOut: 250000000000000000000
  fromInternalBalance: false
value: 1000000000000000000
outputReference: 0
```

Calldata:

```

```

Expected display:

```
Intent: Add liquidity
Pool: 0x5c6Ee304399DBdB9C8Ef030aB642B10820DB8F56
From: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
Recipient: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
Join: Add exact tokens
  Amount in 1: 1000 BAL
  Amount in 2: 1 ETH
  Minimum pool tokens out: 250 B-80BAL-20WETH
Pay from Vault internal balance: false
ETH sent: 1 ETH
Pool tokens out: Not saved
```

Arguments:

```

kind: 0
sender: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
recipient: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
request:
  assets:

    [1]: 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2
  minAmountsOut:
    [0]: 990000000000000000000
    [1]: 990000000000000000
  userData: abi.encode(...)
    exitKind: 1
    bptAmountIn: 300000000000000000000
  toInternalBalance: false
outputReferences: []
```

## Exit the wstETH-WETH pool in recovery mode

Arguments:

```

kind: 3
sender: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
```

## Unsupported join kind

Join kind `2` (`TOKEN_IN_FOR_EXACT_BPT_OUT`) is not described, so it is rejected.

Arguments:

```
poolId: 0x5c6ee304399dbdb9c8ef030ab642b10820db8f56000200000000000000000014
kind: 0
sender: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
recipient: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
request:
  assets:
    [0]: 0xba100000625a3754423978a60c9317c58a424e3D
    [1]: 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2
  maxAmountsIn:
    [0]: 0
    [1]: 1000000000000000000
  userData: abi.encode(...)
    joinKind: 2
    bptAmountOut: 25000000000000000000
    enterTokenIndex: 1
  fromInternalBalance: false
value: 0
outputReference: 0
```

```

```

Expected display:

```

```
